name: duopore-public-kpi-target-attainment
description: See which business measures have reached the targets you set.

interface.longDescription: See which business measures have reached the targets you set. Enter each current value and a target that must be met or stayed below. Get a clear met-or-not-met result and a percentage where it can be worked out. The app uses your targets and figures. It does not set benchmarks, predict results or judge business performance.
defaultPrompt: Which of these business measures have reached my targets?
Check actual values against my minimum and maximum targets.

positive.prompt: Use KPI Target Attainment with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"metrics":[{"id":"K1","label":"Completed reviews","actual":90,"target":100,"rule":"atLeast"},{"id":"K2","label":"Resolution days","actual":4,"target":5,"rule":"atMost"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 of 2 supplied targets met.","rows":[{"id":"K1","label":"Completed reviews","actual":90,"target":100,"rule":"atLeast","targetMet":false,"actualToTargetPercent":90,"percentageAvailable":true,"gapToMeet":10,"status":"notMet"},{"id":"K2","label":"Resolution days","actual":4,"target":5,"rule":"atMost","targetMet":true,"actualToTargetPercent":80,"percentageAvailable":true,"gapToMeet":0,"status":"met"}],"warnings":["Only supplied figures and definitions are assessed. No data source connection, statistical inference or business outcome guarantee.","Actual-to-target percentage rounds to four decimals and does not encode desirability; use the supplied rule, targetMet and unrounded gap."]}
